doc.sourceCode:
/* ==UserStyle==
@name           02. All Star Sites
@namespace      github.com/seenukarthi/Stylus
@version        1.0.0
@description    This Style Sheet for most of the website.
@author         Karthikeyan Vaithilingam
==/UserStyle== */
@-moz-document domain("indianexpress.com"),
domain("science.org"),
domain("files.fm"),
domain("indiatimes.com"),
domain("archive.is"),
domain("rsdelivers.com"),
domain("getpocket.com"),
domain("forbes.com"),
domain("tatler.com"),
domain("git-scm.com"),
domain("cnet.com"),
domain("cultofmac.com"),
domain("edition.cnn.com"),
domain("plex.tv"),
domain("news.ycombinator.com"),
domain("tpb.party"),
domain("thepiratebay.org"),
domain("dailywire.com"),
domain("apple.com"),
domain("arstechnica.com"),
domain("9to5mac.com"),
domain("palatinate.org.uk"),
domain("github.blog"),
domain("iterm2.com"),
domain("hindustantimes.com"),
domain("imdb.com"),
domain("techcrunch.com"),
domain("wired.com"),
domain("wionews.com"),
domain("decrypt.day"),
domain("lttlabs.com"),
domain("axisbank.co.in"),
domain("awardsdaily.com"),
domain("mimecast.com"),
domain("nestogroup.com"),
domain("eater.net"),
domain("ground.news"),
domain("bsky.app"),
domain("theverge.com"),
domain("fossa.com") {
    *:not( pre,
    pre code,
    code,
    .fa,
    .fal,
    .k-icon,
    canvas,
    .glyphicon,
    .shared-icon,
    .material-symbols-sharp,
    [class^="icon-"]) {
        font-family: var(--vknDefaultFontFamily) !important;
    }
}
